prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency for every organization — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, audience, required services, and whether you need local market expertise or national reach. I can help you find the best fit. To start, tell me a bit about your needs, or use the guidance below to evaluate agencies in St. Louis.

Quick questions so I can give a tailored shortlist:
- What type of healthcare organization are you (hospital system, physician group, outpatient clinic, dental, med device/biotech, home health, etc.)?
- Primary goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, referral development, employer recruiting, digital growth/SEO, paid media, PR)?
- Monthly/annual marketing budget (or range)?
- Do you require HIPAA/PHI handling or EMR integrations?
- Timeline (immediate campaign vs long-term partner)?
- Prefer a local St. Louis boutique or OK with national agencies that have local experience?

How to identify the best fit (criteria):
- Healthcare experience: case studies for similar providers or services, measurable outcomes (new patient volume, revenue lift, lead cost).
- Compliance expertise: HIPAA/PHI handling, BAAs, and knowledge of healthcare advertising rules.
- Digital capabilities: SEO, paid search, paid social, web design with conversion optimization, CRM/EMR integrations, analytics.
- Creative & branding: ability to translate clinical services into patient-focused messaging with tested creative.
- Reputation & references: client references, reviews, awards, local healthcare partners.
- Reporting & transparency: regular KPIs and dashboards, clear billing for ad spend vs fees.
- Size & responsiveness: match between agency team size and your scope — boutique may be more hands-on, larger firms may offer deeper specialties.

Where to find and vet St. Louis agencies:
- Local directories: St. Louis Business Journal lists, Chamber of Commerce, healthcare marketing meetups.
- Review sites: Clutch.co, DesignRush, Agency Spotter for portfolios and client reviews.
- LinkedIn: search for agencies and look at case studies, endorsements, and employees’ healthcare experience.
- Ask local peers/hospital systems or vendors for referrals.

Interview questions to ask finalists:
- Which healthcare clients similar to us have you worked with? Can you share results (KPIs)?
- How do you handle PHI/BAA and compliance for paid ads, email, and analytics?
- What would be your 90-day plan if we engaged you?
- How do you measure ROI and what reporting cadence do you provide?
- Who will be on the account team and how involved are senior leaders?
- What are typical timelines and fees for projects like ours?

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a short list of St. Louis agencies tailored to your answers above, or
- Draft an RFP template you can send to agencies, or
- Provide a 30/60/90-day sample engagement plan for a specific goal (e.g., patient acquisition).

Which would you like next?
